surface_mechanism_description: The surface reaction mechanism involves the deposition of ALD W using SiH4 and B2H6 precursors, which induces different metal gate-induced strain due to the polycrystalline phase of SiH4 and the amorphous phase of B2H6. The tensile stress from SiH4 (~2.4 GPa) is higher than that from B2H6 (~0.9 GPa), leading to compressive strain in the channel region and improved device performance.
evidence: It is seen that the ALD W using SiH4 has a higher tensile stress (~2.4 GPa) due to its polycrystalline phase whereas ALD W using B2H6 has a lower tensile stress (~0.9 GPa) due to its amorphous phase.
